notes: The symmetric window mapping uses a private ATen operation and requires a pinned PyTorch compatibility check.
For S query positions and S+64 key positions, bottom-right causal alignment permits k<=q+64; a causal window of 129 also requires k>=q-64. Appended keys are masked.
Fused RoPE writes a masked tail of 64 positions with unchanged rotary arithmetic, avoiding separate K/V padding copies. One key-padding bias is reused across all local layers.
FlexAttention and forced cuDNN accelerated some shapes but each changed two of 208 tested decisions and were rejected.
Final-head Q projection pruning preserved 208 decisions with small probability drift, but the extra small GEMM did not provide a useful latency win.
GEMM selected-kernel data records the actual autotuner winners. Enabling TMA flags does not establish that the selected kernels use TMA.
